reasoning: In March 2016, Google DeepMind's AlphaGo played a five-game match against Lee Sedol, one of the world's top 9-dan professional Go players, winning 4 games to 1. Prior to AlphaGo's victories against European champion Fan Hui in late 2015 and Lee Sedol in 2016, AI experts widely predicted that an AI defeating a top professional Go player was at least a decade away due to the vast search space and complexity of the game.
